memory_update.text: POWL should move to the top of the underfollowed AI-power watchlist because the company disclosed a data-center order exceeding $400 million tied to behind-the-meter on-site generation assets, directly validating electrical balance-of-plant scarcity.

PRIM is a mid-cap utility-services and power-delivery candidate; the key verification path is whether utility backlog and power delivery growth are specifically tied to data-center load growth and interconnection work.

ATKR remains a speculative shadow candidate: data-center applicability is real at the product-description level, but the evidence is not yet strong enough without segment-level revenue or margin linkage.

The AI data-center bottleneck is increasingly visible in electrical orders, switchgear, behind-the-meter generation, utility power delivery, and construction services rather than only in chips or servers.

Need a later Layer 2 pass on transformer manufacturers, busbar suppliers, electrical enclosure vendors, grid interconnection software, commissioning/testing firms, and regional utility exposure near major data-center clusters.

node: AI data-center power, grid interconnection, and electrical balance of plant
summary: Expanded the universe around AI data-center electrical bottlenecks with one reference leader and three less-obvious US-listed second-order beneficiaries. The strongest underfollowed mapping is Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and custom electrical distribution, followed by Primoris for power delivery/substation/grid construction services and Atkore as a more cyclical component supplier whose data-center exposure needs tighter verification. Eaton is included only as a reference anchor because its Electrical Americas order acceleration confirms that data-center demand is already visible in mainstream electrical equipment backlogs.
